description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the I18NService component within the OrangeHRM project. It contains tests to verify functionality related to internationalization translations, caching, and service configuration, specifically within the context of the I18N (Internationalization) module.

classes.name: OrangeHRM	ests	est	est
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the I18NService, verifying internationalization features like translation retrieval, caching, and language switching.

methods.name: testGetI18NDao
methods.description: Tests that the I18NService correctly returns an instance of I18NDao.

methods.name: testGetTranslator
methods.description: Verifies that getTranslator returns a Translator object with correct locale and translations.

methods.name: testGetTranslationCollection
methods.description: Checks that getTranslationCollection correctly maps translation data into a TranslationCollection object.

methods.name: testGenerateCacheKeyPrefixForLang
methods.description: Ensures the cache key prefix for a given language code is generated correctly.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationCacheKey
methods.description: Verifies the translation cache key generation method.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationKeyTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Checks the cache key for the translation key-target array.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationSourceTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Checks the cache key for the source-target array of translations.

methods.name: testGetETagByLangCode
methods.description: Tests retrieving the ETag for a specific language, including cache behavior.

methods.name: testGetETagByLangCodeWithMultipleLanguages
methods.description: Tests ETag retrieval with multiple language support, verifying proper caching and fetching.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesAsJsonString
methods.description: Confirms that translation messages are correctly serialized to a JSON string.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArray
methods.description: Checks the correctness of the key-target translation mapping.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArrayWithInCaseNotCreatedCache
methods.description: Verifies cache invalidation and re-fetching while retrieving key-target translation map.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArray
methods.description: Validates the source-target translation mapping array.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArrayWithInCaseNotCreatedCache
methods.description: Checks cache invalidation and re-fetch for source-target array.

methods.name: testTrans
methods.description: Tests the translation method, including parameter substitution and cache behavior.

methods.name: testTransWithMultipleLanguages
methods.description: Verifies translation behavior across multiple language contexts.

methods.name: testTransBySource
methods.description: Tests translation by source string instead of translation key.

methods.name: getMockI18NDao
methods.description: Creates a mock I18NDao returning specified translation data, with optional call expectations.
